description: This file defines enums, interfaces, and classes related to asynchronous enumeration requests within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes mechanisms for starting, moving to the next element, and disposing of asynchronous enumerations, as well as handling enumeration results and exceptions.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableRequest<T>
classes.description: Abstract base class representing an asynchronous enumerable request in Orleans, providing mechanisms to initialize, invoke, and manage enumeration over grains.

classes.name: AsyncEnumeratorProxy<T>
classes.description: Proxy class implementing IAsyncEnumerator<T> that manages the lifecycle and communication with remote grain enumerators.

classes.name: EnumerationAbortedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that an enumeration was aborted, with serialization support.

methods.name: GetAsyncEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an async enumerator proxy for iterating over grain results.

methods.name: InitializeRequest
methods.description: Initializes the request with a target grain reference and returns the request as an enumerable.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; direct invocation is not supported for async enumerable requests.

methods.name: InvokeImplementation
methods.description: Invokes the actual implementation of the async enumerable request.

methods.name: MoveNextAsync
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next element, handling remote calls and result processing.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the enumerator, releasing resources and notifying the grain.
